mechanism: Testosterone may increase bone resorption and fracture risk in some contexts, potentially opposing zoledronic acid's anti-resorptive effects, while zoledronic acid may potentiate hypogonadism-related bone loss in susceptible patients.
action: Monitor bone mineral density and consider coordinating therapy; ensure adequate calcium and vitamin D supplementation; assess baseline renal function prior to zoledronic acid infusion as testosterone may affect fluid retention.
